title: Pain Neurophysiology Education and Exercise for Adolescents With Chronic Idiopathic Neck Pain
brief_summary: This study compared the effectiveness of pain neurophysiology education and neck/shoulder exercises with no intervention in adolescents with chronic idiopathic neck pain (CINP).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* To be invited to enter the study participants had to have chronic idiopathic neck/shoulder pain, defined as pain felt in the neck/shoulder regions at least once a week in the previous 3 months.

Exclusion Criteria:

* No exclusion criteria
